verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for an auth and user-management platform, since some offer rule or workflow engines, but the pack shows no Clerk feature for user-defined automations that run on their own. Webhooks deliver event notifications, and API keys or M2M tokens authenticate external scripts or cron jobs. Those are building blocks and adjacent features, not an automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
